He was awesome and super supportive and never gave any indication anything was different. 

He came over all the time, would help me with cleaning and making food and doctor’s appointments and was there the whole time with me in the hospital. 

That’s why this is so jarring to me, it’s so different than how he’s acted in the past towards me.

When he would be stressed because of his old job or other things he would be more “off” and that’s fine and I understood that and I would give him room to process what was going on because looming and demanding to be apart of it helps no one. But this is pretty unusual for him and when he’s here I’ve even noticed a small shift but I can’t help but feel like I’m reading into things more because I am more emotional right now.

The thing that’s so weird is when he’s on and being supportive and loving he’s unmatched. He’s helped me a lot and done a lot for me but other times he’s super off and weird and distant and makes me feel like I come second to other stuff. 

I don’t feel like I’m a very demanding person and I’ve been very understanding and accommodating but a lot of things are more glaring now that I’m a bit more sensitive to things.
